name: Smart Search's page in the default FallbackOnly mode, as viewer: index.html carries one Smart Search tag and its head fragment (the page 'search' known and on), the kit registers it on its own (fallback) host, 'Library tools' links #/jfss-search, the page renders there under the title 'Advanced Search' with its search form (the 'Title contains' field) and no 'Page not found' frame, a hard reload renders it again, GET /SmartSearch/Fields serves viewer the catalogue without the administrator-only Path, and no exception of ours. Sandbox data only; changes no setting.

steps.name: index.html: one Smart Search tag, the head fragment once before </head>, and its page state
steps.eval: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => { const s = t.match(/<script type="application\/json" data-jfss-head data-jfss-pages>([^<]*)<\/script>/); return { tags: (t.match(/data-jfss-plugin=/g) || []).length, headFragments: (t.match(/data-jfss-head/g) || []).length, beforeHeadEnd: t.indexOf('data-jfss-head') < t.indexOf('</head>'), state: s ? JSON.parse(s[1]) : null }; })

steps.name: one tag; FallbackOnly; the page 'search' known and on
the kit registered the page on its own (fallback) host
'Library tools' links the page
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer a')].find(x => x.getAttribute('href') === '#/jfss-search'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 ? { text: a.textContent.trim(), section: ((a.closest('.jfkit-nav') || {}).textContent || '').indexOf('Library tools') >= 0 } : false; })()

steps.name: the link reads 'Advanced Search', under 'Library tools'
the page renders on #/jfss-search under its title
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > [data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r) return false; const body = r.querySelector('.jfss-search'); if (!body) return false; return { hash: location.hash, host: r.getAttribute('data-jfss-host'), state: r.getAttribute('data-jfss-state'), text: body.textContent.trim(), headerTitle: (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim(), documentTitle: document.title, notFound: [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > :not([data-jfss-page]) h1')].some(h => h.getClientRects().length > 0) }; })()

steps.name: after the reload: the page again
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > [data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const body = r && r.querySelector('.jfss-search'); return !!body && /Title contains/.test(body.textContent) && location.hash === '#/jfss-search' && (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim() === 'Advanced Search'; })()

steps.name: the client's health report reached the server (POST /SmartSearch/Diagnostics/ClientHealth)
GET /SmartSearch/Fields as viewer
steps.eval: fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('SmartSearch/Fields'), { headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } }).then(async r => { const b = r.ok ? await r.json() : null; return { status: r.status, version: b && b.RegistryVersion, fields: b ? b.Fields.length : 0, path: !!b && b.Fields.some(f => f.Id === 'Path'), adminOnly: b ? b.Fields.filter(f => f.AdminOnly).length : -1, title: b && b.Fields[0].Id, sortKeys: b ? b.SortKeys.length : 0, kinds: b ? b.ItemKinds.join() : '', matches: b ? b.Fields.some(f => f.Operators.includes('Matches')) : true }; })

steps.name: 200; registry 2; the 32 fields but Path, Title first; no Matches (not offered yet); 15 sort keys; the six item kinds
no uncaught exception (the stale CustomRatings tag of the sandbox's index.html is known noise)
